ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Outside`. `rush` is never used, but its transition is there.

Deferred entry into `Inside`. Because `Inside` also has a normal incoming transition (from `rush`), KIELER implements `deferred` differently: `Inside` is entered now, only its own entry action is suppressed, and `First`'s entry action runs (`innerEntry` = 1).
`First`'s delayed transition fires (`step` = 1), at the normal time.
